ucsf.alternative: Severe beta-lactam allergy: levofloxacin or moxifloxacin.
ucsf.duration: Generally 5 days for uncomplicated CAP; apply current stability criteria.
ucsf.notes: Consider MRSA/Pseudomonas coverage only with relevant risk factors.

sfva.first: Use SFVA CAP guideline; outpatient uncomplicated disease lists doxycycline preferred or amoxicillin alternative.
sfva.alternative: Comorbidity/recent antibiotics: combination therapy preferred; levofloxacin alternative.
sfva.notes: Dedicated SFVA CAP guidance is available.

ucsf.first: Use the dedicated UCSF Medical Center HAP/VAP guideline linked from IDMP.
ucsf.alternative: Regimen depends on resistance/MRSA risk and clinical context.
ucsf.duration: Generally 7 days per UCSF IDMP pneumonia page.
ucsf.notes: ZSFG and SFVA have dedicated site-specific HAP/VAP algorithms.

sfva.first: Use VASF stepwise HAP/VAP treatment algorithm.
sfva.notes: Dedicated VASF algorithm is linked from IDMP.

ucsf.first: Therapy depends on cystitis vs pyelonephritis and patient factors.
Non-purulent inpatient: cefazolin; outpatient: cephalexin. Purulent inpatient: vancomycin; outpatient: TMP/SMX.
ucsf.alternative: Alternatives depend on allergy, MRSA history and syndrome.
ucsf.notes: Drain purulent abscesses when feasible; see source for exclusions/severe disease.

ucsf.first: Community mild-moderate secondary peritonitis/abscess: ceftriaxone + metronidazole.
ucsf.alternative: Severe beta-lactam allergy: vancomycin + aztreonam + metronidazole.
ucsf.duration: Stop 4 days after adequate source control for common pathways.
ucsf.notes: Healthcare-associated disease broadens coverage; severe disease may require ID consultation.

ucsf.first: Community-onset adult: ceftriaxone + vancomycin, with or without ampicillin depending on Listeria risk.
ucsf.alternative: Severe penicillin allergy: vancomycin + aztreonam, with or without TMP/SMX for Listeria.
ucsf.notes: Add Listeria coverage for adults >50 or immunocompromised per UCSF guidance.

ucsf.first: Community-acquired unknown source: vancomycin + ceftriaxone OR pip/tazo OR ertapenem if prior ESBL isolation.
ucsf.alternative: Severe beta-lactam allergy: vancomycin + metronidazole + aztreonam.
ucsf.duration: Stop at 48 h if work-up reveals no source; otherwise tailor to source.
ucsf.notes: Healthcare-acquired sepsis uses broader antipseudomonal options; see current source.
